> Maintainer workflow only. Opening this issue does not authorize implementation or alter an approved ADR.

## Work Order ID
NLE-...-WO-...

## OBJECTIVE
State one verifiable outcome.

## CONTEXT
Approved checkpoint, base commit SHA, relevant ADRs, dependency and risk level.

## SCOPE
Only NECESSARY work for this increment.

## OUT OF SCOPE
Explicit exclusions, no unrelated cleanup.

## FILES / SOURCES TO READ
Include checkpoint > ADRs/Ledger > Scope > DoD > Architecture > Requirements.

## REQUIREMENTS
IDs and traceability to tests.

## ARCHITECTURE RULES
Applicable module boundaries and invariants.

## CONSTRAINTS
No external reviewer, no CodeRabbit or mandatory paid CI, no bypass, no force push.

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- [ ] Measurable criteria with evidence
- [ ] No known HIGH/CRITICAL regressions
- [ ] Documentation reflects verified code, not assumptions

## TESTS
Commands and relevant risk category; benchmarks only when applicable.

## DELIVERABLES
Files, PR, Evidence Bundle, risks, proposed Checkpoint Delta.

## REVIEW FORMAT
Português brasileiro: APPROVED / CORRECTION REQUIRED / BLOCKED, with concrete evidence.

## STOP CONDITION
STALE context, unauthorized scope, failed required test or blocker.
